君の心臓とコスモスを見る

name: Kimi no Shinzou to Cosmos wo Miru
storyline: In this story, three troubled high school girls. The tale then shifts to his past, where he meets his destined partner, only to face her congenital heart disease. It’s a story of how each path leads to its own form of happiness.
summary:
In this story, three troubled high school girls. The tale then shifts to his past, where he meets his destined partner, only to face her congenital heart disease. It’s a story of how each path leads to its own form of happiness.

With love from the heart, anytime.

At any time, people can live on.

A visual novel with about 2 hours of playtime.
